name: 30331-mtpcodegen-hy3fp8-tp8
model: tencent/Hy3-FP8, per-tensor FP8, not substituted. 299.9 GB across 101 safetensors shards; 37.5 GB per rank at TP8.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one whole a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism and no DP attention; four 80 GB cards cannot hold 299.9 GB of weights and leave a KV pool.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 120 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `huggingface` data over `openai/openai_humaneval` (name openai_humaneval, split test, 164 rows), single turn, no shared prefix. Each request is one HumanEval `prompt` column -- a Python function signature and its docstring, roughly 60-300 tokens -- generating exactly 512 tokens under `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`. The bound of 120 is below the 164 rows, so no prompt is served twice. Seed 42.
purpose: A Python coding assistant writing 512-token solutions from short docstring prompts, one request at a time, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently, so every
# structured value has to stay on a single line.

model-path: tencent/Hy3-FP8

tp-size: 8

# NEXTN is normalised to EAGLE inside the speculative arg hook, which also auto-fills the draft
# model path from --model-path for this architecture, so no second path is given.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

# Cut down from the checkpoint's 262144; the longest request here is under 900 tokens, and pinning
# it keeps the memory planner from sizing everything for a 256k context.
context-length: 8192

# Pinned rather than left to the auto-fit heuristic, which derives its value per process from what
# is actually free -- a different KV pool is a different scheduler.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
